listenedNotEmitted.reason: REAL DEFECT. Four production listeners (LiveFeed, MarketIndicatorService anti-cheat sync, DataResilienceService, MarketEventManager) wait on this, but the SSE migration replaced the emitter with marketRuntimeSnapshot -> MarketEventConsolidator, which types/marketCanonical.ts documents as the single source of truth. The listeners look superseded rather than starved, but MarketIndicatorService uses this for client/server indicator agreement (anti-cheat), so each consumer must be verified against the consolidator before deletion. Do not delete blind.

REAL DEFECT: both shock channels are dead. Nothing emits volatilityShock (useGameEvents triggers a physics shockwave + shake + sound off it; VisualEffectService also listens), and the parallel shockDetected channel is emitted only by DifficultyV2CompatibilityAdapter, which sits behind the inert modular shell. Volatility shockwaves therefore never fire in a real run. Needs a design call: should the current-authority director emit a shock, or does the feature go? Do not delete the listeners without that call.

effectRegistryStale.reason: EFFECT_POLICIES keys a cooldown on volatilityShock, which nothing emits. Resolve together with allowed.listenedNotEmitted/volatilityShock.
